fire: Farmers digging a well in 1974 uncovered the first terracotta warriors.

neighbours.notes: Survivor of the Vital Articles people census (Qin Shi Huang branch). Probes: 'The terracotta army guards the tomb near Xi'an' 0.52, 'Thousands of clay soldiers stand in rows' 0.20; but 'Qin Shi Huang unified China' 0.03, 秦始皇 0.03, 'burned books and buried scholars' 0.08, 'The army marched across the desert' 0.005, clay pots 0.01. So a terracotta-army unit, not a person unit.
